newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: C&W Manila unit,ING Bank sign $39 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: C&W Manila unit,ING Bank sign $39 mln loan.

text.p: Eastern Telecommunications Philippines Inc (ETPI), an affiliate of Cable & Wireless, said on Thursday it signed a $39 million loan with ING Bank NV to finance the local telephone network of a subsidiary.

ETPI vice-chairman Luis Sison said in a statement that the short-term bridge financing loan will be used to fund the 300,000 telephone lines installation project of Telecommunications Technologies Philippines Inc, an ETPI unit.
The official said the loan was arranged together with telecommunications equipment supplier Alcatel of Europe.
As an international gateway facility operator, ETPI is required to install the 300,000 lines by the year 2000.
